channel.description: Latest articles from The Shawnee News-Star (news-star.com)

item.title: More Americans care for loved ones; few feel prepared for emergencies
item.description: SHAWNEE - Today, millions of Americans serve as caregivers, supporting both young children and aging loved ones, often at the same time. Yet many lack critical lifesaving training, including how to respond in a cardiac arrest emergency.

item.title: Bethel girls overcome host Prague, 57-51
item.description: PRAGUE – Sophomore Hailey Hanmer, making her first career start, drained two 3-point shots on her way to 15 points as the Bethel Lady Wildcats outlasted the Prague Lady Red Devils 57-51 Thursday night.

item.title: Washington girls hand McLoud their first setback of the season
item.description: McLOUD – The Class 4A fourth-ranked McLoud Lady Redskins suffered their first loss of the season Thursday as they were overwhelmed by the 3A top-ranked Washington Lady Warriors 93-57.

item.title: Legislative session updates
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY – Rep. Ryan Eaves, R-Atoka, passed a bill in committee this week that would require public schools to provide annual firearm safety instruction to students.

item.title: District Attorney issues statement on Lincoln County E-911 Trust Authority Forensic Audit
item.description: Pottawatomie/Lincoln County District Attorney Adam Panter, after requesting a forensic audit involving the Lincoln County E-911 Trust Authority, believes a criminal investigation is now warranted.

item.title: Shawnee Parks and Recreation
item.description: Hello Shawnee! Each week, the Shawnee Recreation Center located at 401 N. Bell, formerly called the Senior Center, offers classes and programs for individuals age 55+.

item.title: Emergency Management demonstrates drones at Maud High School
item.description: On Wednesday, Pottawatomie County Emergency Management conducted a drone demonstration to share county emergency management capabilities with the students at Maud High School. "It’s always an honor to educate and inspire young minds about public safety, preparedness, and the technology we use to serve and protect our communities.

item.title: Maud boys slam Schulter in first-round district game; Lady Tigers fall
item.description: MAUD – After a tight first quarter, the Maud Tigers dominated their Class B2 first-round district game Thursday night by slamming Schulter 63-28.

item.title: Tecumseh basketball squads roll to road sweep at Seminole
item.description: SEMINOLE - Tecumseh traveled to Seminole Thursday and swept important conference games.
